# im

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/pkg/im"
```

Package im provides read\-only structs, slices, and maps checked by immutago.

Embed Shared in a struct when callers can save or return its pointer. Embed Scoped when callers must keep the pointer local or pass it to functions that do not save it. Both markers require read\-only fields, including nested data. Owner lets readers load the current Scoped object while a publisher replaces it.

Prepare a Go slice or map in one local variable, then call FreezeSlice or FreezeMap. Freeze reuses its storage without copying entries. Read through the frozen value after that call. Clone returns a separate slice or map to edit.

Run immutago on the packages that use these types. Go build alone does not enforce these rules. See the guides and complete supported operations at https://github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/blob/main/docs/rules.md.

## func Unseal

```go
func Unseal[T any](value Opaque[T]) *T
```

Unseal returns the wrapped pointer, or nil for the zero Opaque. Only the package that declares T can use Unseal.

## type FrozenMap

FrozenMap is a read\-only map. Its zero value is empty. K and V must be immutable. Copies share the same read\-only entries.

```go
type FrozenMap[K comparable, V any] struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

### func FreezeMap

```go
func FreezeMap[K comparable, V any](values map[K]V) FrozenMap[K, V]
```

FreezeMap makes values read\-only without copying entries or allocating. Keep values in one local variable before Freeze. Afterward, read through the returned FrozenMap. The checker rejects aliases and use of the old map. Run immutago to enforce these rules; Freeze performs no runtime validation.

### func \(FrozenMap\[K, V\]\) All

```go
func (m FrozenMap[K, V]) All() iter.Seq2[K, V]
```

All returns an iterator over key\-value pairs in unspecified order. It reads frozen storage directly without making a copy. Each invocation starts a new map traversal and stops as soon as yield returns false.

### func \(FrozenMap\[K, V\]\) Clone

```go
func (m FrozenMap[K, V]) Clone() map[K]V
```

Clone returns an independent native map in O\(n\) time and space. It copies keys and values by value and preserves nil. Mutating the copy does not change the frozen map. References still point to the same immutable objects; immutable types make deeper copying unnecessary.

### func \(FrozenMap\[K, V\]\) Get

```go
func (m FrozenMap[K, V]) Get(key K) (V, bool)
```

Get returns the value for key and whether it exists, using native map lookup. It allocates no storage and preserves Go's key equality rules.

### func \(FrozenMap\[K, V\]\) Len

```go
func (m FrozenMap[K, V]) Len() int
```

Len returns the number of entries in O\(1\) time without allocations.

## type FrozenSlice

FrozenSlice is a read\-only slice. Its zero value is empty. T must be immutable. Copies share the same read\-only entries.

```go
type FrozenSlice[T any] struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

### func FreezeSlice

```go
func FreezeSlice[T any](values []T) FrozenSlice[T]
```

FreezeSlice makes values read\-only without copying entries or allocating. Keep values in one local variable before Freeze. Afterward, read through the returned FrozenSlice. The checker rejects aliases and use of the old slice. Run immutago to enforce these rules; Freeze performs no runtime validation.

### func \(FrozenSlice\[T\]\) All

```go
func (s FrozenSlice[T]) All() iter.Seq2[int, T]
```

All returns an iterator over index\-value pairs in increasing index order. It reads frozen storage directly without making a copy. Each invocation starts at index zero and stops as soon as yield returns false.

### func \(FrozenSlice\[T\]\) At

```go
func (s FrozenSlice[T]) At(index int) T
```

At returns the element at index in O\(1\) time without allocations. It panics if index is out of range, as native slice indexing does.

### func \(FrozenSlice\[T\]\) Clone

```go
func (s FrozenSlice[T]) Clone() []T
```

Clone returns an independent native slice in O\(n\) time and space. It copies elements by value and preserves nil. Mutating the copy does not change the frozen slice. References still point to the same immutable objects; immutable element types make deeper copying unnecessary.

### func \(FrozenSlice\[T\]\) Len

```go
func (s FrozenSlice[T]) Len() int
```

Len returns the number of elements in O\(1\) time without allocations.

## type Opaque

Opaque holds a pointer to a value that the analyzer does not look inside. It is one of the two trust markers of immutago, with proc.UncheckedDependency: the analyzer does not prove that the value is immutable. The package that declares T trusts its own code to never change the value after Seal.

Opaque is an allowed stored type. Any package can store, copy, and pass it. Only the package that declares T can use Seal and Unseal, so other packages reach the value only through the API of that package. See https://github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/blob/main/docs/opaque.md for the complete forms.

```go
type Opaque[T any] struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

### func Seal

```go
func Seal[T any](value *T) Opaque[T]
```

Seal wraps value. The package that declares T must not change the value after this call.

## type Owner

Owner stores one pointer to an immutable Scoped object. Declare a slot as a package variable or a direct named field of an unmarked struct. Its zero value is empty. An Owner value must not be copied. See https://github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/blob/main/docs/owner.md for the complete forms.

```go
type Owner[T any] struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

### func \(\*Owner\[T\]\) Load

```go
func (o *Owner[T]) Load() *T
```

Load returns the current pointer, or nil if the slot is empty. Keep the pointer local or pass it to a function that does not save it. It remains valid after a later Store. Go's garbage collector manages its lifetime.

### func \(\*Owner\[T\]\) Store

```go
func (o *Owner[T]) Store(value *T)
```

Store publishes a freshly constructed object.

## type Scoped

Scoped marks a struct with read\-only fields. Its pointers cannot be saved or returned. Use Owner to publish a new Scoped object for other code to read. Embed it by value. A named field or pointer embedding does not mark the struct. See https://github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/blob/main/docs/scoped.md for the complete forms.

```go
type Scoped struct{}
```

## type Shared

Shared marks a struct with read\-only fields. Its pointers can be saved or returned. Embed it by value. A named field or pointer embedding does not mark the struct. See https://github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/blob/main/docs/shared.md for the complete forms.

```go
type Shared struct{}
```
